written.myAnswer: Efficiency is the ratio of useful output energy to total input energy. A system cannot be 100% efficient because some energy is wasted, for example as heat, so its useful output is less than its input.

Efficiency = useful output energy ÷ total input energy; percentage efficiency = (useful output energy ÷ total input energy) × 100. A real machine’s efficiency is limited because some energy is inevitably wasted, so it cannot convert all input energy into useful output energy.
